brand.brand_accents: original logo and controlled emphasis; never substitute another palette

slide.scale_behavior: CSS scaling of fixed logical slide

web.layout: responsive semantic reflow; do not shrink a slide and call it a mobile layout

rules.editable_editorial_text: native HTML text; not SVG or rasterized text
rules.artwork: separate source-traceable image or vector layers
rules.background: white; no gradient or decorative fill
rules.geometry: hairline CAD/ISO-informed grid; no decorative rounded corners, shadows, thick borders
rules.evidence: separate structural, visual, adapter-layer, and hands-on-edit tests
rules.metaphors: Main Street Copy's copy/print/pack/ship and UPS Ground/FedEx Ground are current instructional analogies; historical aviation and older convenience-retail demonstrations are retired for new work. PARCELS=architectural responsibilities; PRIME=governed handoff.
rules.story_medium: white-ground technical editorial illustration; no photorealistic/stock imagery or full-slide flattened text
rules.canonical_case: Main Street Copy, a proposed untested document-services business; no real carrier affiliation or shipment success asserted
rules.pdr_thesis: Productive Digital Real Estate: domain=address/endpoint, compute/storage/network/access=facility, workflows/APIs/tools=equipment; operation/value require independent inspection
rules.narration_change_control: Owner authorized a coherent new V4 candidate, but exact revised narration requires a new spoken-text lock/hash and new audio alignment. Preserve V1/October 20 source history.
